newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's IBCA reaffirms Nedcor ratings.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's IBCA reaffirms Nedcor ratings.

text.p: Rating agency IBCA said on Wednesday it had reaffirmed Nedcor Bank and holding company Nedcor Ltd's domestic ratings.
It said Nedcor Bank's short-term rating would remain A1+ and its long-term rating AA, while Nedcor Ltd's short-term rating would also remain at A1+.
Nedcor Bank's legal rating was set at 2 and Nedcor Ltd's at 5.
IBCA said the ratings indicated the highest capacity for the timely repayment in the short-term and a very low expectation of investment risk in the long-term.
"Adverse changes in business, economic or financial conditions may increase investment risk, albeit not very significantly," it said in a statement.
Nedcor Bank is 53.4 percent owned by life assurance giant Old Mutual through Nedcor Ltd.
"Given Old Mutual's significant resources, we are of the opinion that additional capital would be made available to Nedcor Bank should it be needed," it said.

While the Reserve Bank had no obligation to provide solvency support and there was no deposit insurance in South Africa, it said that due to Nedcor Bank's size and importance to the domestic economy, solvency support would be forthcoming.
"A legal rating for the bank is assigned on this basis."
